scope.flow: FRouter.getAmountsOut price oracle relying on FPair.kLast after swap
scope.environment: FPair/FRouter AMM contract with EXECUTOR_ROLE-restricted reserve changes

entities.name: Observer or downstream contract reading getAmountsOut

statements.text: Reserve-altering operations are restricted to holders of EXECUTOR_ROLE.
FPair.kLast() returns the initial constant product value.
FPair.swap() does not update _pool.k with the product of the new reserves, so kLast remains stale after a trade.
FRouter.getAmountsOut computes price from current reserves together with the stale k value.
Anyone can read the skewed price by calling the public view function getAmountsOut after an executor's trade.
getAmountsOut returns fundamentally incorrect, persistently inaccurate prices after any trade.
The getAmountsOut view function is an unreliable oracle for observers and downstream contracts.
The getAmountsOut price oracle should return prices consistent with current pool reserves and the pool constant product rather than a stale k value.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether an executor trade actually occurred in the reported scenario; the stale-k failure is described conditionally after any trade.
No specific downstream contract or loss amount is identified.
The kLast stale value is described as the initial constant product, but the exact update semantics in swap() are not detailed beyond non-update.
